author: Aleix
body:
Hi Federico,
Thank you for your article, really clear.

One question: If I'm going to test the service itself (using .and.callThrough()), What is the advantage of spy on it instead of calling it directly?

Thanks

author: Federico Hatoum
body:
Hi Aleix.

You can certainly just call a service directly and examine the return value. Using spies, however, gives you more information about the call. For example, only with a spy can you use expect(foo).toHaveBeenCalled() or expect(bar).toHaveBeenCalledWith('hi').
